text:
amanda_cs: Quick sync: Vanguard dedicated bring-up starts tonight. Two asks from account team: (1) clear billing visibility during warmup, (2) a short exec summary post-run. Also note renewal conversation next quarter  want zero surprises.

leo_vanguard: thanks! main ask is we don't get charged peak-prod rates during priming. also want a single POC for paging.

marisol_csm: i'll be the POC for first 72h. i'll also own the exec one-pager template. billing: can we apply a warmup flag so usage is visible separately?

ben_sre: yes. we can add header x-warmup-session:vanguard-8742 and set warmup=true in billing pipeline. we'll also emit metric tags warmup:true.

anya_ops: ops note  reserve confirmed: RSVC-8742 in eu-west-1. doing allocation now. ETA 30m.

amanda_cs: run plan summary (short):
- pre-prime caches 10h before step1
- staged ramp: 5%,20%,40%,70%,100% over 36h with 20-60m soaks
- autoscale policy + fallback (see below)
- billing tags + reporting dashboard (marisol/ben)
- chaos drill at step5 (low-risk node drain) to validate fallbacks

ben_sre: autoscale policy (initial):
```
metric: p95_ms
up: >320 for 3m -> scale up by 25%
down: <220 for 6m -> scale down by 20%
min: 3 reps
max: 48 reps
cooldown_up: 60s
cooldown_down: 180s
```

and target_gpu_util: 70% avg. Also setting per-rep concurrent_tokens=1000.

leo_vanguard: can you add an automatic cap so we don't overshoot committed spend? We have a committed baseline and want burst only up to 150% of baseline.

ben_sre: we can set hard cap at 1.5x baseline replicas and configure autoscaler to respect budgeting guardrails. will document.

marisol_csm: billing ask: can we produce a CSV with warmup vs prod tokens and a simple cost delta? finance needs that within 24h after completion.

anya_ops: will ensure logs and billing export tagged to project/vanguard-8742 and drop to s3://billing-exports/vanguard-8742/warmup.csv

deploy-bot: warmup-load job started id=lt-1825554321 profile=vanguard-warmup step=1 target_qps=600

ben_sre: step1 ok. p95=210ms, gpu_util=28%. moving after 45m soak.

marisol_csm: quick customer feedback from Leo: they want a short "what to expect" message to their ops team for each step. i'll send a template.

amanda_cs: please include clear rollback triggers in that message (p95>800ms sustained 10m, error_rate>1%).

chaos-bot: scheduled chaos window at step=5: planned node_drain test 15m after full traffic for 10m. Owner: ben_sre.

ben_sre: noted. we'll run the node drain with canary fallback: 25% traffic diversion to quantized-small variant, automatic circuit-breaker to 0% if errors >0.5% in 5m.

leo_vanguard: is there a risk this affects user-facing SLA? we need assurance for their customers.

amanda_cs: we'll keep customer-facing SLA unaffected by running warmup traffic on separate pool and tagging. any unexpected affects -> immediate cut and manual failover. I'll own comms to Vanguard execs.

deploy-bot: loadtest update: step=4 completed avg_qps=6840 errors=0 p95=340ms

anya_ops: starting embeddings prefetch now (they use hybrid rerank). prefetch job id ep-182555-1, duration planned 6h.

ben_sre: during step3 we saw a short-lived queue buildup when a replica restarted. adjusted grace_period to 90s and increased drain timeout. recorded in runbook.

marisol_csm: i've uploaded exec one-pager draft to internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/vanguard-8742/exec-summary . colors: green/amber/red + a 1-line recommendation.

amanda_cs: risk note for renewal: if we hit sustained >5% degraded steps or billing mismatch, flag for customer success weekly review. marisol please capture any feedback in the renewal playbook.

leo_vanguard: appreciate the transparency. paging contact for us: ops-leo@vanguard.com. will be oncall for first 48h.

ben_sre: step5 (full) starting now. running planned chaos test at T+15m. monitoring dashboards and will hold if any red flags.

deploy-bot: chaos-bot triggered node_drain test for pool-p-12, diversion rule applied, job id cd-182555-5

ben_sre: chaos passed: no error spike, fallback diversion stable at 25%, recovery within 80s. marking step5 green.

marisol_csm: collecting customer sentiment: Leo said initial latency dips were expected and ok. i'll send the exec summary and the billing CSV after we finalize.

amanda_cs: final checklist before closeout:
- runbook entries finalized + post-run notes (amanda)
- billing CSV + export (anya)
- exec summary + renewal flags captured (marisol)
- run a 72h review meeting (all)

leo_vanguard: thanks team. happy with approach. talk at 72h review.
